reviewer.method: Actual view_image inspection of every within-case byte-distinct original; SHA-256 computed from original PNG bytes.

summary: 实际查看 17 个 case 的 37 张原图，跳过并登记 40 张同 case 字节完全重复图。发现 3 项 P2，无 P1。默认字号总体可读；最大字号账户状态和长页采集需要修正。缺少鸿蒙实际截图，不能判定复刻或美学提升通过。

coverage.displayNote: view_image returned original files rendered at 946×2048 in the review interface; no source image was modified.

findings.title: 登录错误态没有错误内容
findings.observation: 唯一 login--error 图显示正常邮箱表单和获取验证码按钮，未出现可供审查的错误提示。
findings.impact: 无法检查失败解释、恢复入口及错误文字换行，也不能将此图计为 error 状态覆盖。
findings.requiredChange: 在截图前等待确定的登录错误 UI 可见，再重新采集该状态；不要仅凭 case 名称视为覆盖。

findings.title: 最大字号的邮箱绑定状态被省略号取代
findings.observation: scroll-1 的“绑定邮箱”右侧只显示“…”；默认字号对应值为“未绑定”。
findings.impact: 大字号用户不能读出关键账户状态。
findings.requiredChange: 辅助大字号将标签和值纵向排列，或让值获得完整换行空间；重拍未绑定及登录方式行。

findings.title: 长页滚动跳跃漏掉中间内容
findings.observation: 账户大字号顶图仅显示登录方式行前部，而 scroll-1 已从绑定邮箱开始；密码表单顶图只露出首个新密码输入框上沿，scroll-1 已从该框下沿开始，后续图均没有完整展示该框。
findings.impact: 即使末尾已可见，也不能据这些图证明 all-overflow-content 完整覆盖或控件无截断。
findings.requiredChange: 按滚动视口实际高度分段采集并留重叠，确保登录方式整行及首个新密码输入框在至少一张图中完整可见；复核固定页头/页脚后的有效视口。

notes.note: 最大字号两模型选项成为高度不同的胶囊；可改为等宽纵向选项以保持清晰层次。URL/模型输入值在未聚焦时截断，需要实际编辑/横向阅读验证，静态图不足以判为交互失效。
只有顶图呈现注销弹窗；后续 scroll 图变为普通账户页。visible-state 可使用顶图，但后续图不可标为确认弹窗。
export 与 local 的对应顶图/末尾图完全相同；hosted 与 missing-config 对应图也相同。所有这些 case 的独特图都实际独立查看。只证明导出入口和默认模型配置缺失 UI，不代表导出完成或 hosted 服务成功。

imagesReviewed.name: account--password-form--scroll-2
imagesReviewed.observation: 导出与数据说明、MILO 页脚以及退出/注销清晰，视觉末尾锚点存在。

coverageLimits: No real HarmonyOS screenshots were supplied or reviewed. This is not a paired parity acceptance, and it cannot establish aesthetic improvement over HarmonyOS.
All images are from the supplied iOS screenshot index. This review does not call simulator captures physical-iPhone tests.
Login/account/network fixtures do not prove AGC registration/login, real password reset, key storage, connectivity, subscription activation, destructive-action execution or export success.
No keyboard-visible captures, VoiceOver interaction, alternate device sizes or separate theme variants were reviewed within this scope.
Large font is visibly rendered, but exact system category and capture/build/source provenance were not independently validated in this visual-only review.

Visual terminal anchors were inspected. Runtime totalContentHeight/viewportHeight/maxScrollOffset and numerical overlap were not supplied here; repeated last frames alone do not prove full-content coverage.
Account export images show the export controls but no native share sheet or exported artifact. Export functionality requires separate journey/artifact evidence.
Per-case no-blocking-visual-finding is limited to supplied visible content; it is not a final pass and does not override pending case ledger entries.
